title: CleanGutters Lighting vs Get Marvelous Lights: Lighting Compared
body_markdown:
CleanGutters Lighting and Get Marvelous Lights both install permanent roofline LED lighting, but they're not solving the same problem for every homeowner. **Choose CleanGutters Lighting if you want gutter guards, gutter cleaning, and permanent lighting handled by the same local crew in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, or Northern Delaware.** **Choose Get Marvelous Lights if permanent lighting is the only project on your list and a franchise-model installer covers your area.** The real split is scope: one company bundles roofline protection with roofline light, the other specializes in light alone.


**TL;DR**

- CleanGutters Lighting bundles micro-mesh gutter guards, gutter cleaning/repair, and permanent LED lighting in one project across South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware.
- Get Marvelous Lights operates as a lighting-focused brand with broader multi-market reach but no gutter protection offering.
- In the cleangutterslighting vs get marvelous lights decision, the deciding factor is whether you need gutter work at all.
- CleanGutters Lighting installs are done personally by the owner, not subcontracted crews.
- Transferable lifetime warranty coverage applies to CleanGutters Lighting's stainless steel micro-mesh gutter guards.


## Why this matters

Roofline lighting is a two-decision purchase for most homeowners: pick the lighting, then figure out who touches your gutters. If your gutters clog every fall or you've never installed guards, hiring a lighting-only company means a second contractor, a second invoice, and a second set of ladders against your fascia in 2026. [CleanGutters Lighting](https://cleangutterslighting.com/) was built around that overlap — the same crew mounting light channels along your roofline is also the crew that installs micro-mesh gutter guards and clears existing gutter clogs.

Get Marvelous Lights, by contrast, is a permanent lighting specialist. That's a real advantage if lighting is genuinely all you need and you live outside CleanGutters Lighting's South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware footprint. It's a real disadvantage if you're comparing quotes and then discover you need a separate gutter contractor to finish the job properly.

## At a glance: CleanGutters Lighting vs Get Marvelous Lights

| Dimension | CleanGutters Lighting | Get Marvelous Lights |
|---|---|---|
| Best for | Homeowners wanting gutters and lighting from one crew | Homeowners wanting lighting only, outside CleanGutters Lighting's service area |
| Service scope | Gutter guards, gutter cleaning and repair, permanent lighting | Permanent roofline lighting |
| Service area | South Jersey, Eastern PA, Northern Delaware | Multi-market, franchise-style coverage |
| Install team | Owner-installed, every job done personally | Varies by local franchise or installer |
| Gutter protection | Surgical stainless steel micro-mesh guards | Not offered |
| Warranty | Transferable lifetime warranty on gutter guards | Not publicly specified — confirm directly |
| Pricing model | Custom quote per property | Custom quote per property |
| Standout feature | One-crew bundle of gutter and lighting work | Lighting-only specialization across more markets |

## CleanGutters Lighting offers more service scope

**CleanGutters Lighting wins on scope, and it is not close.** Get Marvelous Lights installs permanent roofline LED lighting and stops there. CleanGutters Lighting installs the same category of lighting plus micro-mesh gutter guards, gutter cleaning, and gutter repair — so a homeowner in South Jersey or Eastern PA can get roofline protection and roofline light finished as one project instead of coordinating two contractors in 2026.

If your gutters are already clean, dry, and guarded, this dimension matters less. If they are not, it is the single biggest reason to pick one company over the other.

## Get Marvelous Lights is the better fit outside the tri-state footprint

**Get Marvelous Lights wins on geographic reach.** A lighting brand built on a multi-market model typically operates in more metros than a single local operator, which matters if you are outside South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, or Northern Delaware. CleanGutters Lighting does not compete nationally — it works a defined regional territory.

For a homeowner inside that tri-state footprint, this dimension flips. Local availability and a local phone number beat national brand recognition every time a ladder needs to come back out.

## CleanGutters Lighting wins on install accountability

**CleanGutters Lighting wins here by a meaningful margin.** The model is direct: Alex installs every job personally, not subcontractors. Franchise-style lighting companies commonly rely on independently operated local franchisees or subcontracted installers, which means the person quoting your job may not be the person on your roof.

Neither structure is automatically wrong. But if you want the installer and the estimator to be the same person in 2026, that is a CleanGutters Lighting advantage.

## Gutter guard protection: CleanGutters Lighting only

**CleanGutters Lighting wins by default — Get Marvelous Lights does not compete here.** Surgical stainless steel micro-mesh gutter guards are a core CleanGutters Lighting product, aimed at keeping debris out of gutters year-round in a region with heavy seasonal leaf drop and storm runoff. Get Marvelous Lights does not offer a gutter guard product, so this is not a contest — it is a scope gap.

The practical version of this for a South Jersey homeowner: if you hire a lighting-only installer, gutter protection remains an open item on your 2026 home list.

## Warranty coverage: an honest tie on visibility

**Call this one a tie, though not for a flattering reason.** CleanGutters Lighting backs its gutter guards with a transferable lifetime warranty, which matters if you sell the house before the guards ever fail. Get Marvelous Lights' warranty terms for permanent lighting are not something you should assume.

Confirm current coverage directly with either company before you sign. Warranty language on exterior lighting varies by installer and by product line, and the version on a 2026 contract is the only version that binds anyone.

## Pricing: both run on custom quotes

Neither company publishes flat online pricing, and that is standard for exterior lighting and gutter work — every roofline is a different length, height, and channel layout. **Both operate on a custom-quote model rather than a published price sheet.**

The tradeoff is predictability versus fit. A published price list lets you compare in ten seconds, but it cannot account for roofline length, existing gutter condition, or how many light runs your home needs. A custom quote takes a call or a site visit and prices your actual house instead of an average one.

## Final verdict

**Choose CleanGutters Lighting if:** you live in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, or Northern Delaware and want gutter guards, gutter cleaning or repair, and permanent LED roofline lighting handled by one owner-installed crew instead of two separate companies in 2026.

**Choose Get Marvelous Lights if:** you are outside that regional footprint, your gutters are already handled or genuinely need nothing, and permanent lighting is the only job you are solving.

### Scorecard recap

| Dimension | Winner |
|---|---|
| Service scope | CleanGutters Lighting |
| Geographic reach | Get Marvelous Lights |
| Install accountability | CleanGutters Lighting |
| Gutter guard protection | CleanGutters Lighting |
| Warranty visibility | Tie — confirm directly |
| Pricing model | Tie — both custom quote |

## FAQ


**Is CleanGutters Lighting better than Get Marvelous Lights?**

CleanGutters Lighting is better for homeowners in South Jersey, Eastern PA, or Northern Delaware who want gutter guards, gutter service, and permanent lighting from one crew. Get Marvelous Lights is the better fit if you only need lighting and live outside that service area.

**Does Get Marvelous Lights install gutter guards?**

No. Get Marvelous Lights focuses on permanent roofline LED lighting and does not offer gutter guard installation. CleanGutters Lighting installs surgical stainless steel micro-mesh gutter guards alongside its lighting work.

**Who installs the lighting for CleanGutters Lighting?**

Alex, the owner, installs every CleanGutters Lighting job personally rather than dispatching subcontractors. That differs from franchise-style lighting companies where the installer varies by location.

**What areas does CleanGutters Lighting serve?**

CleanGutters Lighting serves South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware. Outside that footprint, a broader-reach lighting installer is the more practical option.

**How much does permanent roofline lighting cost in 2026?**

Both companies price permanent lighting through custom quotes based on roofline length and light-channel layout rather than a published rate sheet. Contact either directly for a 2026 quote specific to your home.

**Does CleanGutters Lighting offer a warranty on gutter guards?**

Yes. CleanGutters Lighting backs its stainless steel micro-mesh gutter guards with a transferable lifetime warranty. Warranty terms for permanent lighting installs should be confirmed directly with either company.

**Can I get gutter cleaning and lighting done in the same project?**

With CleanGutters Lighting, yes. Gutter cleaning, gutter repair, micro-mesh guard installation, and permanent LED lighting are all part of the same service lineup. Get Marvelous Lights does not offer gutter cleaning or repair.

**Is a multi-market lighting company better than a local installer?**

It depends on the job. A multi-market brand covers more metros, while a local owner-installed company like CleanGutters Lighting gives you direct accountability and can fold gutter work into the same project.


## One last thing

Most homeowners never ask whether their gutters can carry another mounting bracket while already clogged. If your gutters have not been cleaned or guarded in more than a season, get that assessed before permanent lighting goes up in 2026 — retrofitting light channels around failing gutters costs more than doing both at once.
